text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув is totally disheartened by
Silence
Suzuka's overwhelming abilities. I
open a dialogue
with her in the hopes of
getting her back on her
feet.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I tell Эйр Грув that I see her as a

challenger—someone who continually
challenges
herself to become the ideal
for all Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As if to punctuate these words, she sees
the fruits
of her labors in Мэдзиро Добер,
who works
tirelessly with Эйр Грув as
her ideal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Realizing that no matter how high the
wall in her
path, she must simply
continue facing up to it, Air
Groove
stands resolute once more.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now we can truly focus on the Sapporo
Kinen,
where Эйр Грув must show the
world that the
ideal she represents as
Empress lives on!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
